conf.description: M365 UAL teams api-pull: Graph audit-query JSON parse, common-field rename, RecordType map, unmapped fields to o365.audit.*

conf.comment: M365 UAL teams, api-pull format (Graph audit-query async flow; requires the broad AuditLogsQuery.Read.All since no Teams-scoped permission exists). Extracts the JSON record, renames straightforward common fields plus clientIp (no split needed per the map), maps auditLogRecordType to numeric RecordType (25 for microsoftTeams per the map; microsoftTeamsAdmin/microsoftTeamsDevice have no documented number and fall to -1, a documented gap), and routes userType/userId/objectId/administrativeUnits/auditData to custom o365.audit.* fields. Lowest-volume, lowest-forensic-value dataset on this map; no extra tagging is called for on this format.

functions.description: parse the Graph auditLogRecord JSON the REST Collector delivered in _raw
batch rename of straightforward mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets
canonical event time in _time (never @timestamp; Elastic dest maps it)
computed transforms, custom-field routing, and event.dataset
